deities: Goddess Khodiyar Mata (a form of Durga)

history.summary: The present temple was constructed in 1911 by the then Maharaja of Bhavnagar. Khodiyar Maa, a warrior goddess born in the Charan caste around 700 AD, is the kuldevi (ancestral goddess) of Bhavnagar's royal family. Legend holds that Maharaja Wakhatsinghji Gohil (ruled 1748-1816), a devotee of the goddess, prayed at her shrine at Mandel and she agreed to follow him to Sihor, then the capital; when he turned to look, she stopped at Rajpara and made it her abode. The temple stands on the banks of Tataniya Wali Lake with a huge mandap housing the idol. CSV town corrected: the temple is at Rajpara village, ~15-16 km from Bhavnagar city, not in the city itself. Opening hours conflict: trawell.in reports 4 AM-10 PM, another source 6 AM-8 PM (verify). Coordinates are approximate (POI listings, ~11 km west of Bhavnagar).

name: Shri Khodiyar Mata Temple
town_description: Rajpara is a village in Bhavnagar district on the Bhavnagar-Rajkot highway, about 15 km from Bhavnagar city, known for the Khodiyar Mata shrine on the banks of Tataniya Wali Lake.
